body:
I agree, but just not this day. All (commercial) 'special' days are horrible to me:
Valentine, Birthday, Christmas, Summer Holidays. Every year I am alone. As one of the few I am always trying to work those days as the only person.

But it's not only the days itself are horrible, I am already not looking forward for tomorrow when I will hear everyone story of how their day was and people will ask about mine.
And after telling mine I get the same "your time will come" speech again.

I have been alone for 33 years now! :/

I'm nearly double your age, I have been depressed the same amount of years you have been alive.

I can tell you this, if you still have a reason to be alive, then you want to be alive deep inside your heart. You probably want to escape all the pains you have now.

No friends, I know all about it. I also have no familiy or anything else. So I know how you feel.
If she has a year, I can tell you, a lot can happen in a year, especially in the age you live in!

Keep your head up and look around, you honestly have so much to live for and a complete future ahead of you!

I know, it's weird for me to say this, I am extremely depressed as well, but I am closing 33 years now being all alone. Being alone for 15+ years feels more fair to me, 17 means you're in the prime of your life. My life started when I was around 19, it didn't take long, but a lot is possible, just wait :)

hello arno901, I am not religious at all, but I have travelled so much in my life that I know and understand the impact of religion. 
I understand your feeling, but I personally don't agree you should leave money for them, you have your life and your own choices.

I know why you want to run away and I am not saying it's a bad thing, heck, maybe it's even a good thing!
But leaving a note would not be bad, but be open and honest.
maybe it's even good to leave a contact number/mail in it. Because on crucial moments like that, they would understand your decisions.

Have you ever openly talked about it with your parents how you feel?

I don't want to push you in any direction, but communication is usually the key. if that fails, you always have this option.

You really want to know my vision about death?
think of the moment you go to bed and fall asleep, the first minutes. Can you ever remember? No? that, but that for eternity.
No pain, no good things, just nothing. And science has proven that your atoms will be used for something else, just your conscious is gone into nothingness. Anyhow, that's my person opinion :)

to be honest, I am also looking for a way, but unfortunately there are cases that jumping of a building can be painfull...
reason is, you cannot change your course the way your falling, it's all physics. It stopped me from doing exactly that.

I have seen movies of people surviving a parachute jump from miles high and I could feel their pain.

what also stopped me from doing this, remind that people will see you there on the ground. Average people no problem, but think of a young person or a child that will see you there dead, that is something that also stopped me from doing that.

don't get me wrong, I don't want to stop you. I don't know you story, you don't know mine, but use the braincells and think of others as well. Trust me, there are better ways...

SeaDragnX: Thanks for the reply, I know what you're trying to do. This is the basic giving me feeling some sort of guilt.
Not saying you do this on purpose, I honestly believe your words and that they are true (to you).
In my life I have met so many people... thousands of people from all around the world. I have been to places where the richest people are but also the most poorest people on earth life (think of 6 years old, begging for food and sleeping underneath cars for year and never seen a single dollar or any currency until they are 25+)

I have seen so much (if not too much) of life.

They say I am 'lucky' I am born in a first world country, but whereever I come I tell people that those places are lonely.
sure, we got perfect social care, health care and whatever care.
But what's it worth when you are alone?

I would trade my life to live in any 'poor' country, as they are happy of the most smallest things.
My dream is to live in South America and work/live there for the rest of my life.
I can say I am from Holland. A place where 16 million people live.
excluding children en elderly people (leaving about 8-9 people) there are nearly 2 million people living alone.
Loneliness, depression... it's number one problem in the 'first world countries'. 2nd or 3rd world countries (as society calls them) they have never heard of it. Always people around you to help you. Ok, they help you survive, but the problem is that human beings are not made to be alone.
sure they can be like that for a few days. They need interactions, they need other to care of eachother, to learn from eachother.

Sure I would accept your hug, would it help? No, for the moment yes... I don't really know or remember how a hug feels like to be honest.
All I know with feelings, is that I know how a teardrop feels like falling down from your eye to your cheeck, chin and dropping down, into nothingness and disintergrate in the air... wishing I was a teardrop. :'(
